== Card credits ==
Joseph Graham is credited with the original concept of one Players Committee [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card is in [[Virtual Set 10]] (released 8 January 2019).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Commander Brandei (V)|•Commander Brandei (V)]] || [[Virtual Set 10]] || 8 January 2019 || "Original concept by Joseph Graham"
